subject: Invoice delivery preference and AP enrollment for GreenSky Health
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@greenskyhealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@greenskyhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + invoice delivery options for onboarding

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the onboarding docs — we’re getting close to our first invoice run and I wanted to confirm how Redwood will send invoices and what the AP team needs from us to set up electronic delivery. A couple quick questions: 

- Can you send the first few invoices to AP by email while we complete portal enrollment?
- Do you have a PDF invoice sample and a remit/payee name we can validate against our PO system?
- We’ll need Redwood’s W9 (US tax) for our vendor file.

I copied our AP inbox (ap@greenskyhealth.com). If you can outline the steps for portal enrollment, that’d be helpful — some of our hospitals require SFTP or a portal integration for automated ingestion.

Best,
Olivia Grant
Director, Strategic Ops
GreenSky Health
olivia@greenskyhealth.com

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@greenskyhealth.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@greenskyhealth.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + invoice delivery options for onboarding

Hi Olivia — great to hear you’re close to the first bill. Short answers up front and then a suggested plan: 

- Yes — we can send the first two invoices as password-protected PDFs to ap@greenskyhealth.com while your portal enrollment completes. After that we prefer portal delivery for reliability and reconciliation.
- I attached a sample PDF invoice (invoice_sample_email.pdf) and our W9 (Redwood_W9.pdf). Please confirm the remit name and tax ID match your vendor file.
- Portal options: SFTP, portal (preferred, with webhook), or API push. Enrollment typically takes 5–7 business days if we have an AP contact and test credentials.

Suggested timeline:
1) I’ll send invoice #1 via email today (PDF, password: first4zip).
2) Kimberly (cc’d) will kick off the portal enrollment and share the SFTP test window by EOD.
3) Once the portal is active we’ll flip delivery and send copies to the AP inbox for the next 30 days until you confirm full ingestion.

Questions: do you need invoices to include the PO number on the invoice header or just on the line items? Also — are you VAT registered anywhere we should tag?

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Attachments: invoice_sample_email.pdf (PDF invoice sample), Redwood_W9.pdf (W9)

From: Accounts Payable <ap@greenskyhealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, Olivia Grant <olivia@greenskyhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + invoice delivery options for onboarding

Hi Jasmine — this is AP at GreenSky. Thanks for the quick reply and the attachments. A few items from our side: 

- PO# GS-2027-331 will be referenced on all invoices. We need the PO number visible in the invoice header for automated matching.
- Email delivery is ok for the first two invoices. Please password-protect PDFs and send the password in a separate email.
- We are planning to enroll in your portal (SFTP) but need SFTP host, username template, and a test window; automated pickup will be needed for hospital-led ingestion.
- We also need your ACH/payee details on the remittance block (routing + acct last4) or indicate if you require a wire instead.

Can someone from Redwood Ops share the SFTP spec and a sample filename convention?

Thanks,
AP Team
Accounts Payable 
ap@greenskyhealth.com

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Accounts Payable <ap@greenskyhealth.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia@greenskyhealth.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + invoice delivery options for onboarding

Hi AP + Olivia — looping in Rishi for a quick exception and to provide the SFTP spec. Rishi — can we confirm the two-email grace period (email PDFs for first 2 invoices) and provide the SFTP details below?

SFTP spec (preview):
- Host: sftp.redwood-invoice.com
- Path: /greensky/ingest/invoices/
- Username pattern: greensky_{entity}@redwood
- Expected filename: GS-<YYYYMMDD>-INV-<invoice-number>.pdf
- Test window: Mon–Fri 09:00–11:00 PST (we’ll hold a 30-minute pickup window)

Remittance info (for AP file): Redwood, Inc. — ACH (routing: 122000661, acct ending: 2147). If you prefer wire, we’ll provide wire instructions via secure link.

Rishi — jasmine proposed a flip to portal after 2 invoices; can we approve that for onboarding?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Finance Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
